scope: Francisco Mario Matos Matas, Shaila María Cogolludo Ramos and Antonio Cogolludo Rojas across the Sun Park Owners' Community organ, the actor-specific Montelanza/Molina-linked dissenting-owner perimeter, Pamanil/Pamalexsha administration, the 2017-2018 security/access phase, the Acosta Matos/CAM perimeter and later corporate continuity.
attribution_rule: Every row separates documented role/action, attributed allegation and open proof. A family, corporate, representative or chronological link does not transfer another actor's act, knowledge, intent, benefit or liability.

phases.label: Montelanza/Molina-linked dissident-owner origin and Community capture question
phases.context: The controlled record shows owner-by-owner CEXP accession/non-adherence, a defined Molina-linked split by 2009, the 2-Feb-2011 governance change and the 22-Jun-2011 debt/vote/authority matrix. This does not make every Molina-named owner one faction or prove common purpose.

actions.action: Recorded in Community Administrator functions; Pamanil is ratified for administration/maintenance while debt, voting, document custody and litigation are addressed.
actions.connection: This places FMMM inside the Community mechanism that followed the AAS/Molina-linked governance shift.
actions.limit: Lawful appointment, contract, mandate, authorship of each debt/certificate and intent remain separate proof questions.

phases.label: Representation and administration consolidation
phases.context: The Community record becomes a three-person documentary cluster without collapsing identities.

actions.action: Appears with Shaila in the Pamanil/Community communications perimeter.
actions.connection: Carries the 2011 administrator lane into the 2014 dispute over convocation, debt, voting and authority.
actions.limit: A communication does not prove universal Community authority or criminal purpose.

actions.action: Appears in the Pamanil/Community communication sent shortly before the 10-Apr meeting.
actions.connection: First controlled date placing Shaila in the administration/communications environment.
actions.limit: No corporate office or universal mandate is proved by this document alone.

actions.action: Represented Cristina Molina Petit at the notarial Community meeting.
actions.connection: Direct bridge from Antonio into the named Molina-linked owner/representation perimeter.
actions.limit: Representation of Cristina does not prove representation of every Molina-linked owner or a common plan.

actions.action: Again represented Cristina Molina Petit in the surviving Community act.
actions.connection: Shows continuity of the Antonio↔Cristina representation lane.
actions.limit: The act-specific power and legal effect remain source-specific.

actions.action: Continues as Community administrator while the file records incomplete accounts, recalculated balances/certification authority and a Pamanil→Pamalexsha provider transition.
actions.connection: Preserves document/debt/administration continuity through the entity-label change.
actions.limit: No universal legal succession from Pamanil to Pamalexsha is proved.

actions.action: Represented Inversiones Salinetas at the Community meeting.
actions.connection: Places Antonio in another named owner/corporate lane within the same Community organ.
actions.limit: Representation does not prove ownership, control of the Community or shared intent.

actions.action: Participated in the recorded PwC/LPB/Community working meeting on operation, costs, debt, records and insolvency.
actions.connection: Connects Community administration and the debt/records architecture to professional notice and later insolvency questions.
actions.limit: It was not an Owners' Community ACTA; transcript/authentication limits remain.

phases.label: Named Community offices, Pamalexsha administration and security/access
phases.context: This is the strongest jointly documented/attributed phase for the three, but their functions remain different.

actions.action: Elected Community president.
actions.connection: Puts Antonio at the head of the organ during the period leading into security/access measures.
actions.limit: Election validity, title/power and each instruction remain separately auditable.

actions.action: Recorded as Community treasurer; the next-day Pamalexsha email signed 'Shaila' announced Antonio's presidency and that Pamalexsha had been renewed for administration services.
actions.connection: Connects Shaila personally to Community communication and the administration-services vehicle.
actions.limit: Email authorship/role does not prove every accounting, bank, voting or access act.

actions.action: Recorded as secretary-administrator; Pamalexsha/FMMM administration continues and bank/certification/claim functions are approved in the meeting record.
actions.connection: Extends the 2011 administration/custody lane into the immediate pre-2018 period.
actions.limit: Each certificate, bank act, debt figure and instruction requires its own source.

actions.action: Chaired the meeting that authorised the president to hire security up to €8,500/month for access control/preservation.
actions.connection: Direct office-level bridge into the security/access route immediately preceding 7 June.
actions.limit: The minute does not itself prove who later instructed guards/locksmiths, spatial scope, possession transfer or unlawful purpose.

actions.action: Recorded as treasurer; appears in the voting/administrative environment of the security meeting.
actions.connection: Places her in the organ at the access/security hinge.
actions.limit: Exact vote, bank/accounting act, communication or implementation remains actor-specific.

actions.action: Recorded as secretary-administrator in the security/access meeting.
actions.connection: Document and administration custody meets the new security/access authority path.
actions.limit: The minute alone does not prove operational instruction or physical implementation.

actions.action: Project Sun Rock alleges an authority/implementation role in the material-control operation.
actions.connection: Community presidency is the asserted bridge between the 18-May resolution and practical access/security implementation.
actions.limit: Provider contract, payer, instructions, presence, keys/locks acts and reaction must be proved individually.

actions.action: Project Sun Rock alleges a treasury/voting/administrative/access-rule role in implementation.
actions.connection: The allegation links her Community/Pamalexsha administrative lane to the 2018 operational phase.
actions.limit: Direct instruction, presence, bank use, communications and exact intervention remain open proof.

actions.action: Project Sun Rock alleges continuity from administration/debt/records into material implementation.
actions.connection: This is the asserted FMMM bridge from the earlier dissident/Community mechanism to the Acosta Matos/CAM phase.
actions.limit: Direct instruction, physical act, purpose and benefit must be shown actor by actor.

phases.label: Acosta Matos/CAM perimeter interface
phases.context: CAM's credit/title entry and unit acquisitions are separate from the Community organ. The investigative question is where the two structures interacted and who supplied authority, information or implementation.

actions.action: Community presidency overlaps in time with CAM's credit/title entry and the 2018 security/access route.
actions.connection: The controlled inquiry tests whether president/security functions became an authority bridge used by CAM/Acosta Matos.
actions.limit: Temporal overlap and office do not prove CAM instruction, agreement or unlawful purpose.

actions.action: Treasury/administrative/voting role overlaps the same CAM entry and access period.
actions.connection: The controlled inquiry tests records, accounting, voting lists, communications and access rules for CAM-linked use.
actions.limit: No automatic transfer of CAM conduct or knowledge.

actions.action: Secretary-administrator/document-custody continuity spans CAM's entry, the 2018 access phase and the later 2022 Community/project meeting.
actions.connection: This is the longest personal documentary bridge between the earlier Community mechanism and the later Acosta Matos project phase.
actions.limit: Continuity does not by itself prove a common criminal plan.

actions.action: Continues in secretary-administrator/bank-authority lane while JDAM chairs the Community project meeting.
actions.connection: Creates a direct later Community↔Acosta Matos project interface requiring transaction/document tracing.
actions.limit: Exact instructions, benefit, causation and legal authority remain source-specific.

phases.label: Later corporate continuity and disclosure
phases.context: Later corporate facts can identify custody, economic relationships and disclosure questions, but must not be projected backward as proof of earlier conduct.

actions.action: Official BORME records place Antonio as Pamalexsha's initial sole administrator, later sole administrator of Noalpa and in Santa Lucia Real Estate offices.
actions.connection: Objectively connects Antonio's Community period to later corporate vehicles in the same personal/professional network.
actions.limit: Noalpa/Santa Lucia are not thereby proved to have operated Sun Park or shared a criminal purpose.

actions.action: Official BORME records later powers to Shaila in Noalpa and Pamalexsha.
actions.connection: Supports later corporate continuity and custody/authority questions.
actions.limit: These powers must not be backdated to 2014, 2017 or 2018.

actions.action: Official records place FMMM and José Daniel Acosta Matos together on Orion's board and FMMM among AGM power-holders.
actions.connection: Creates a later objective FMMM↔Acosta Matos corporate overlap.
actions.limit: A later board/power relationship does not prove earlier Sun Park coordination, knowledge or wrongdoing.

contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.source: Email 'Preguntas para la testificación del 25 de Junio de 2018' with attachment 'Cristo prep up.pdf'
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.meaning: 251 contemporaneous proposed questions already connect JDAM, LPAM, FMMM, Antonio, Shaila, the Molina/Montelanza-linked perimeter, Pamanil/Pamalexsha, Community debt/voting, ACTUA, security/access, the Insolvency Administrator and court-authority questions before the 20/31-Jul-2018 DP1132 declarations.
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.limit: Party-side counsel-preparation material. It proves contemporaneous questioning and investigative scope, not truth, counsel adoption, filing, judicial use or answer.

contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.source: Email package 'RELACION MOLINA Y MATOS REGISTRADA - empresas y cargos'
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.meaning: Shows contemporaneous effort to map CAM, Pamanil/Pamalexsha, Molina-linked entities and Community/professional actors.
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.limit: Research/advocacy package; does not itself prove the relationships asserted beyond its underlying registry documents.

contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.source: Q&A Penal 1132/2018 - CAM, Matos, Cogolludos, Borja
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.meaning: Shows that by July 2018 the investigation expressly tested CAM/JDAM, FMMM, Antonio, Shaila, Molina-linked owners, Pamanil/Pamalexsha and Community/security questions as one connected hypothesis.
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.limit: Question list/advocacy material, not adjudicated fact.

contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.source: Email to counsel requesting the draft 'contra FMMM, Cogolludo y Shaila'
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.meaning: Shows contemporaneous grouping of the trio in contemplated criminal work.
contemporaneous_private_investigative_ma.limit: Proves the existence of the contemplated theory, not its truth or filing status.

conclusion: The strongest source-led continuity is a relay, not a single undifferentiated group: actor-specific Montelanza/Molina-linked owner positions and representation feed into the 2011 Community debt/vote/authority mechanism; FMMM/Pamanil provide the earliest continuous administration/custody lane; Antonio and Shaila enter by 2014; all three hold named Community/administration roles by 2017; the 18-May-2018 security/access resolution is the strongest documented three-person Community hinge; 7-Jun-2018 is the strongest attributed operational convergence with the Acosta Matos/CAM perimeter; later corporate links provide disclosure/custody context but cannot be backdated.
open_proof: original powers/proxies for each represented owner and meeting
FMMM appointment/contract/remuneration and document/bank custody chain
security provider contract, payer, instructions, keys/locksmith logs and spatial scope
CAM acquisition deed/payment/seller chain for each relevant unit
actor-specific communications with CAM/JDAM/LPAM and Insolvency Administrator
2022 bank, levy, project and implementation records
certified corporate/shareholder history for later Pamalexsha/AGM/Orion links
